prompts.title: Moon
prompts.text: ​A high-quality 10-second cinematic video. The person in the image reaches up, grabs the glowing full moon, and gently pulls it down from the sky. As the moon is lowered, the surrounding landscape plunges into dramatic darkness, with only distant, sparkling city lights illuminating the deep background. The girl then lifts the moon and carefully places it back into the night sky, instantly restoring the magical, bright moonlight across the scene. The video concludes with impressive, glowing 3D graphic text appearing on the screen that reads: "AMIN AI WORLD".
